# Pull request

## Scope

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and relevant issue. Identify any consequential decision and its owner approval.

## Evidence

List actual commands/scenarios, revision, platform and results. State what was not run. Separate repository checks, application tests, packaged-output inspection and owner playtesting.

## Review

- [ ] Scope is authorized; unrelated work and original inputs are preserved.
- [ ] Documentation and unreleased changelog are current.
- [ ] Privacy commitments hold; no user media, secrets, private paths or raw logs are included.
- [ ] Security boundaries, dependencies and workflow permissions were reviewed.
- [ ] AGPL and third-party licenses/notices were reviewed; fixtures have exact rights records.
- [ ] Test claims have evidence; historical results are preserved.

Mark inapplicable items explicitly with an explanation. Do not attach songs, full lyrics or sensitive reproductions. Security issues use the private channel in SECURITY.md.
